apply_rotation_transform: apply hadamard rotation to a huggingface causal lm model and register online hooks
rotate_linear_by_Q: rotate a linear layer weight matrix by a given rotation matrix Q on input or output side
fuse_ln_linear: fuse layernorm parameters into adjacent linear layer weights and biases in place
register_online_hooks: register online hadamard pre-forward hooks on down_proj and o_proj modules for inference
replace_layernorms_with_rmsnorm: replace all layernorm modules in a model with rmsnorm modules that skip mean subtraction
